+from pydantic import AliasPath, BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
+
+
+def test_model_construct_does_not_keep_alias_path_root_as_extra():
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        first: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('payload', 'first'))
+        second: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('payload', 'second'))
+
+    model = Model.model_construct(
+        payload={'first': 1, 'second': 2, 'ignored': 'not a model extra'},
+        trace_id='request-123',
+    )
+
+    assert model.first == 1
+    assert model.second == 2
+    assert model.model_extra == {'trace_id': 'request-123'}
+    assert model.model_dump() == {'first': 1, 'second': 2, 'trace_id': 'request-123'}
+
+
+def test_model_construct_alias_path_root_removed_when_no_other_extras():
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        value: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('payload', 'value'))
+
+    model = Model.model_construct(payload={'value': 10, 'ignored': 'not extra'})
+
+    assert model.value == 10
+    assert model.model_extra == {}
+    assert model.model_dump() == {'value': 10}
+
+
+def test_model_construct_multiple_alias_paths_can_share_one_consumed_root():
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        name: str = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('payload', 'name'))
+        count: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('payload', 'count'))
+        enabled: bool = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('payload', 'enabled'))
+
+    model = Model.model_construct(
+        payload={'name': 'job', 'count': 4, 'enabled': True},
+        source='scheduler',
+    )
+
+    assert model.name == 'job'
+    assert model.count == 4
+    assert model.enabled is True
+    assert model.model_extra == {'source': 'scheduler'}
+
+
+def test_model_construct_failed_alias_path_does_not_consume_root():
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        value: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('payload', 'missing'), default=5)
+
+    model = Model.model_construct(payload={'other': 7}, trace_id='request-789')
+
+    assert model.value == 5
+    assert model.model_extra == {'payload': {'other': 7}, 'trace_id': 'request-789'}
+
+
+def test_model_construct_plain_alias_extra_behavior_is_unchanged():
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        value: int = Field(alias='external_value')
+
+    model = Model.model_construct(external_value=3, trace_id='request-456')
+
+    assert model.value == 3
+    assert model.model_extra == {'trace_id': 'request-456'}
+
+
+def test_model_construct_alias_path_with_extra_ignore_still_ignores_extras():
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore')
+
+        value: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('payload', 'value'))
+
+    model = Model.model_construct(payload={'value': 12}, trace_id='request-ignore')
+
+    assert model.value == 12
+    assert model.model_extra is None
+    assert model.model_dump() == {'value': 12}
